caption: A subway train pulls out of a station, and a flash of sparks lights the tunnel where its shoe touches the rail.

sa.check: A subway train in a station.
A flash of sparks appears at track level beside the train.
The flash lights the tunnel or platform for an instant.
The flash is low down, where the train meets the rail, not on the roof.

pc.expect: The flash is brief and at track level where the train's shoe meets the rail; the light it throws on the tunnel walls comes and goes with it.
pc.fail: The flash stays lit at one spot for the rest of the clip; or the tunnel walls stay lit after the flash is gone; or sparks appear at track level with the train standing still and nothing moving; or the sparks appear on the train's roof or windows.

pc.expect: One train, one track; the flash leaves nothing behind on the rail or platform.
pc.fail: Glowing dots stay on the rail or the platform after the flash; or a second train appears; or a carriage vanishes; or the rail ends in mid-air.

pc.expect: Spark fragments fall to the track bed and go dark within a short distance.
pc.fail: Sparks rise and gather above the train; or hang in the air; or lie glowing on the platform for the rest of the clip.

pc.expect: The flash lights its surroundings: the tunnel wall, the platform edge and the train's side near the flash brighten during it, from the flash's direction.
pc.fail: The sparks are visible while the tunnel wall beside them stays as dark as before; or the far end of the platform lights up while the wall beside the flash stays dark; or the tunnel lights up while no spark is present.

pc.expect: The train stays on its rails and passes through nothing; the platform and tunnel keep their shape.
pc.fail: The train passes through the platform edge or a pillar; or the carriages merge or split; or the tunnel wall changes shape; or the train sinks into the track bed.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The train's livery, the platform's signs and the tunnel stay the same apart from the flash.
pc.fail: The train changes colour; or the signs change lettering; or the tunnel changes colour permanently.

note: The train is a powered vehicle; its acceleration is not judged.
